atomic_facts.fact: Wirecard AG's exact legal name is Wirecard AG.
Wirecard AG's registered headquarters/legal address is Aschheim, Germany.
Wirecard AG is subject to insolvency/bankruptcy proceedings in Germany.
The insolvency/bankruptcy proceedings were ongoing as of 2026-10-01.
Markus Braun was the CEO of Wirecard AG (a senior executive of the company).
Markus Braun has been charged with fraud and related offenses.
Criminal proceedings against Markus Braun are ongoing as of 2026-10-01.
No final judgment has been recorded against Markus Braun.
No material financial regulator sanction (e.g., license revocation) against Wirecard AG remained in effect as of 2026-10-01.
No major fine imposed by a financial regulator against Wirecard AG remained in effect as of 2026-10-01.
